comment: 11yo female (pediatric), CMMRD confirmed on germline testing — biallelic PMS2 pathogenic variants (compound heterozygous, both parents asymptomatic Lynch carriers). Workup prompted by multiple café-au-lait macules + sibling diagnosed with anaplastic glioma at age 7. Currently asymptomatic, no malignancy yet detected. CMMRD lifetime cancer risk approaches 100% by adolescence; first malignancy often in first decade. Cancer spectrum: hematologic, CNS, early-onset CRC, sarcoma. Fires RF-CMMRD-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: low-grade glioma, CRC). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-CMMRD-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (per C4CMMRD 2014: whole-body MRI annually + brain MRI q6mo from age 2 + colonoscopy q6mo from age 6 + upper GI + small-bowel capsule annual from age 8 + CBC + SPEP + abdominal US q6mo); alternative = IND-CMMRD-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + symptom-driven workup, declining intensified surveillance).
